name: Seinaru Yoru ni Loli Santa
original_name: 聖なる夜にロリサンタ
source:
Alone on the holy night before Christmas, the guy was visited by a cute santa's helper
who will give him any one present. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126241.html]DLsite English[/url]]
